_about: The Opening plan's one settings file (companion/opening_plan). Every list, time and number of the playbook is here, so a later playbook is a new file, not new code. Display only: nothing here places an order. See companion/opening_plan/__init__.py for where each number comes from.
name: OV OR1 shares

buttons._about: Step 4 row buttons (companion/plan_entries.py), only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_BUTTONS=1 and EDGE_TRADER_BREAK_ENTRY=1. Start value from the fast-open design (max 3 flips), not yet approved by Ash.

tape._about: Brief 15: Edge Scanner's open tape (scanner/open_tape.py), read by companion/opening_plan/tape.py for the shadow and the armed plan. One LAN GET to Edge Scanner, inside Step 2's approved link; Edge Scanner answers from memory and asks Alpaca for nothing more. On 2026-11-13 the recorder read a snapshot every 0.50 s (840 in 7 minutes, request p50 48 ms, p95 143 ms, max 488 ms), the snapshot's minute bar became the 09:30 bar at 09:31:00.08-0.65 ET, and SPY's newest trade was 60-150 ms old at arrival (busy names), COIN and CRWD 0.4-1 s (p95 4.5 s).

every_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
every_seconds.why: half the recorder's 0.5 s poll (2026-11-13: 2.00 snapshots a second), so a new snapshot is seen within about 0.25 s

timeout_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
timeout_seconds.why: a memory read on the LAN; a late answer is a problem, never waited for

stale_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
stale_seconds.why: Edge Scanner's newest snapshot to now: 0.5 s poll + 0.25 s read + the request (2026-11-13 p95 143 ms, 220 ms in 09:30:00-30)

feed_late_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
feed_late_seconds.why: SPY's newest trade or quote to the answer in hand; 2026-11-13 SPY trades were 60-150 ms old at arrival plus up to about 0.75 s of polling

automatic._about: Step 5, shadow: what the automatic OR1 plan WOULD do (companion/opening_plan/engine.py). Nothing here sends, changes or cancels an order. Every number is a start number from the design (project memory ov-fast-open-design and ov-entries-failure-rules, 2026-11-13) that Ash has not approved; the tick study and shadow mornings are meant to set them.

range_final_wait_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash

cap_r.note: start number, not approved by Ash

cap_min.note: start number, not approved by Ash

cap_max_pct_of_price.note: start number, not approved by Ash

pullback_wait_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash

flip_line.note: start number, not approved by Ash

max_flips.note: start number, not approved by Ash

watch_until_et.note: start number, not approved by Ash

stale_after_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash

max_shares.note: the ticket's cap, companion/bracket.py MAX_SHARES; tests/test_opening_plan_shadow.py checks they match

max_notional.note: the ticket's cap, companion/bracket.py MAX_NOTIONAL; tests/test_opening_plan_shadow.py checks they match

shadow_from_et.note: live shadow window start, as Edge Scanner's opening recorder (scanner/open_recorder.py FROM_ET)

shadow_until_et.note: live shadow window end, as Edge Scanner's opening recorder (scanner/open_recorder.py UNTIL_ET)

shadow_every_seconds.note: how often the live shadow reads Step 2's feed; the feed itself asks Edge Scanner at most every feed.picks_every_seconds

armed._about: Step 6, the armed send (companion/plan_auto, brief 16), only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_AUTO=1 and after Ash's Arm click. Every number is a start number from briefs 14 and 16 and the architect's rulings of 2026-11-13 15:47 and 16:05 UTC that Ash has not approved. The fast watch ends at automatic.watch_until_et.

arm_from_et.note: start number, not approved by Ash; picks freeze at 09:25 ET

arm_until_et.note: start number, not approved by Ash

act_from_et.note: start number, not approved by Ash; the 09:30 bar ends then

orders_per_pick.note: start number, not approved by Ash

orders_per_day.note: start number, not approved by Ash

calls_per_minute.note: start number, not approved by Ash; counts and refuses sends only (architect, 2026-11-13 15:47 UTC); with the poller's 32-50 a minute it stays under Schwab's 120

calls_per_send.note: the code's worst case (architect, 2026-11-13 16:02 UTC): 4 usual (the quote in break_entry.prepare, the POST, two status reads after a 201, fork PR #15), 5 when an earlier close or partial on the name still has an open status (Trader._blocked -> _unresolved_close reads that order once); tests/test_plan_auto.py pins both

calls_per_cancel.note: the code's worst case: Trader.cancel_entry reads the order, cancels, and reads back up to ten times; never refused by the calls bound, logged with each cancel; tests/test_plan_auto.py pins it

every_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash; how often the armed plan reads the open tape (brief 15 tape.every_seconds)

end_grace_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash; a backstop: the watch-end cancels run from watch_until_et until this much later, then the arm ends. Sized from the worst case (architect's review, 2026-11-13 16:21 UTC): one confirmed cancel is up to about 6.7 s (a read, the cancel and ten read-backs 0.25 s apart at 0.35 s a call), so four take up to about 27 s

clock_ahead_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash; data stamped more than this after our clock makes the reading unusable (the clock looks behind)

orders_per_day_with_flips.note: start number, not approved by Ash; only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_AUTO_FLIP=1 (Step 7, companion/plan_auto/flip.py): the day's 4 entries and 4 flips or re-levels in all. Orders per pick then becomes orders_per_pick + automatic.max_flips + relevels_per_pick (brief 17 item 5)

swap_recheck_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash; only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_AUTO_FLIP=1 (Step 7, companion/plan_auto/flip.py): after a flip's or re-level's confirmed cancel, how long the send half reads the tape again, a tick (every_seconds) apart, while the new reading is unusable or its price stale; then nothing rests (architect's notes on PR #28, 2026-11-13 16:50 UTC)
swap_recheck_seconds.why: on 2026-11-13 two of five names had quotes 0.4 to 0.5 s old on arrival against the 0.5 s stale limit, and one tape timeout does the same; before the cancel would_flip comes again, after it there is one entry to place

relevels_per_pick.note: start number, not approved by Ash; Step 7 (brief 17): how often the armed plan may cancel and place the same side again when the 09:30 bar moves the range by more than one cent. Flips use automatic.max_flips, shared with the row's Flip button
